# Regexes over class names (path form, no .class). One per line. See .github/scripts/dump_api.py.
# ---- Minecraft: core data types
^net/minecraft/(core|util|resources|nbt|tags|sounds)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/core/(particles|registries)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/(SharedConstants|ChatFormatting)$
^net/minecraft/commands/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/commands/arguments/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
# ---- Minecraft: world
^net/minecraft/world/(entity|damagesource|effect|phys|food|inventory|item|scores|flag|entity/ai/attributes|entity/player|entity/projectile|entity/monster|entity/animal|entity/decoration|entity/npc|entity/boss|entity/ai/goal|entity/ai/targeting|entity/ai/control|entity/ai/navigation)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/world/level/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/world/level/(block|block/state|block/entity|material|gameevent|chunk|pathfinder|storage|entity|redstone|saveddata|levelgen)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/world/level/block/state/properties/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/world/(Difficulty|InteractionHand|InteractionResult|InteractionResultHolder|Container|SimpleContainer|Nameable|MenuProvider|ItemInteractionResult)$
# ---- Minecraft: server / network
^net/minecraft/server/(level|players|MinecraftServer|commands)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/server/network/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/network/(chat|codec|syncher|protocol)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/network/(FriendlyByteBuf|RegistryFriendlyByteBuf)$
^net/minecraft/network/protocol/(common|game)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
# ---- Minecraft: client rendering
^net/minecraft/client/(Minecraft|Options|CameraType|Camera|KeyMapping|Timer|DeltaTracker)$
^net/minecraft/client/renderer/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/renderer/(entity|entity/layers|texture|blockentity|culling)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/model/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/model/geom/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/model/geom/builders/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/player/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/multiplayer/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/particle/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/resources/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/resources/model/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/minecraft/client/gui/(GuiGraphics|Font)$
^com/mojang/blaze3d/(vertex|systems|platform)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^com/mojang/math/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^com/mojang/brigadier/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^com/mojang/brigadier/(builder|context|arguments)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^org/joml/(Vector[234][fdi]|Matrix[34][fd]|Quaternion[fd]|Math|AxisAngle4f)$
# ---- NeoForge
^net/neoforged/bus/api/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/neoforged/neoforge/(event|event/entity|event/entity/living|event/entity/player|event/tick|event/level|common|network|network/handling|network/registration|registries|attachment|items|fluids|capabilities)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/neoforged/neoforge/client/(event|extensions|extensions/common|model|gui)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/neoforged/neoforge/(common|network)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/neoforged/neoforge/network/(PacketDistributor|handling/IPayloadContext)$
^net/neoforged/fml/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
^net/neoforged/fml/(common|event/lifecycle|loading)/[A-Za-z0-9_$]+$
# ---- ManasCore + Tensura (everything public)
^io/github/manasmods/manascore/.*$
^io/github/manasmods/tensura/.*$
# ---- Mojang libraries referenced by Minecraft's signatures (DataFixerUpper codecs, authlib profile)
^com/mojang/(serialization|datafixers|authlib|logging|blaze3d|math)/.*$
^com/mojang/(brigadier)/.*$
# (re-run marker 3: javap -constants)
